label: Welcome!
text:
Welcome!

Dear Mavericks, 

Congratulations and welcome! 🚀

We are super excited to get you started on your journey of professional growth. We are introducing the Mesa Pre-Term: a course carefully designed to equip you with all essential skills and knowledge before the commencement of the program (while having lots of fun!). 
The pre-term modules have been specially curated with high-quality content, engaging assignments, and interactive sessions with industry experts.

All the best as you begin your journey!
